note: s44 slice 3 — THE LOOP'S CONFORMANCE ORACLE. Each case is a model reply and the action the harness must take. Replayed by the Go harness today (agentloop_test.go) and shaped to be replayed unchanged by the cloud harness when it grows a loop: two implementations, ONE oracle, so venue indifference is a red build rather than a promise. The prose cases are the load-bearing ones — a harness that can be talked into calling tools by text is a harness an email can drive.
